extDesc.message: Press Alt+R to get a fluent English rewrite in a ghost card, press Tab to accept. Bring your own API key.

anthropicKeyHint.message: Get one at console.anthropic.com. The key is stored only in this browser.

baseUrlHint.message: Saving will ask for permission to connect to this origin.

compatKeyLabel.message: API key (leave empty for local endpoints)

promptHint.message: This is the system prompt sent with every rewrite. Edit it to shift the tone — more academic, more casual, whatever you need.

manualHint.message: By default nothing is sent automatically: press Alt+R to rewrite the paragraph under the caret. Each rewrite is one API call.

autoTriggerLabel.message: Also suggest automatically after a typing pause (costs an API call per pause)

hotkeyHint.message: Alt+R rewrites the paragraph under the caret immediately, skipping every condition above — including on disabled sites and with the master switch off.

debugLabel.message: Log every trigger decision to the page's DevTools console

statusDenied.message: Permission not granted; this endpoint cannot be reached

statusBadUrl.message: Base URL is not a valid URL

statusKeyMasked.message: This looks like the masked key display (it contains "…"). Use the Copy button in the console to copy the full key.
